<a id="done-when"></a>

## Done when

A procedure exists for the job, it passes the drift check, and the operator's approval (or its absence) is on record.

<a id="mistakes"></a>

## Mistakes

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| m-1 | Writing a precondition only in prose or in "common mistakes". If a step can fail because something isn't ready, make it a `pre` check that refuses with its fix. |
| m-2 | Booking in the main checkout or on main: `new` refuses; make a feature worktree first. |
| m-3 | Copying a shared script into the folder. Only what this procedure alone uses lives here; shared tooling is listed in `uses`. |
